summary.text: Nembe (Brass) was a canoe city-state. In 1895 its war canoes raided the Royal Niger Company’s depot at Akassa; British reprisals followed.

arms.text: War canoes; over a thousand men went to Akassa.
Guns and cannon from the Atlantic trade.

record.text: Nembe’s canoes took and burned the Company’s depot at Akassa.
A British naval reprisal burned Nembe.
